description_en: Updates an RTC cloud recording task
name: UpdateRtcCloudRecording

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This ID is returned by StartRtcCloudRecording. You can only update tasks that are running or in an abnormal state
parameters.help_zh: 任务id。由 StartRtcCloudRecording 返回，只支持更新运行中或异常中的任务
parameters.name: task_id

fields.help_en:
The video input stream type of the user ID. This parameter is valid only when a video stream is subscribed to (StreamType=2). Valid values:

0: camera (default value)

1: screen sharing
fields.help_zh:
该UserId的视频输入流类型，仅针对订阅视频流时（StreamType=2）有效。取值：

0：摄像头。（默认值）

1：屏幕共享
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The media type of the subscribed user ID. Valid values:

0: original stream, which includes both audio and video (default value)

1: audio-only stream

2: video-only stream
fields.help_zh:
订阅的UserId的媒体类型。取值：

0：原始流，即包括音频和视频。（默认值）

1：仅音频流。

2：仅视频流
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en:
The list of subscribed user IDs. In single-stream recording mode, each user ID is recorded separately. In mixed-stream recording mode, the audio and video streams of all user IDs are mixed into a single audio and video stream.

The array supports up to 17 elements
fields.help_zh:
订阅的UserId信息列表，单流录制模式下，会对其中每个UserId分别进行录制；混流录制模式下，会将所有UserId的音视频混合到一组音视频中。

数组内最多支持17个元素
fields.name: subscribe_user_id_list

parameters.help_zh: 更新后的订阅相关参数
parameters.name: subscribe_params

fields.help_en:
The display mode for video output. Valid values:
0: crop (default value)
1: scale and display with a black background
fields.help_zh:
画面输出时的显示模式。取值：
0：裁剪。（默认值）
1：缩放并显示黑底
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the background image. The maximum length is 2,048 characters
fields.help_zh: 背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The global background image for stream mixing
fields.name: mix_background

fields.help_en: The height of the pane, as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0,1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 窗格高度，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The video input stream type of the user ID. If UserId is not specified, the SourceType setting here is invalid. Valid values:
0: camera (default value)
1: screen sharing

The combination of UserId and SourceType specified here must be included in SubscribeUserIdList
fields.help_zh:
该UserId的视频输入流类型。不填写UserId时，此处设置SourceType无效。取值：
0：摄像头。（默认值）
1：屏幕共享。

这里设置的UserId与SourceType的组合必须包含在SubscribeUserIdList中
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The display mode for sub-picture output. Valid values:
0: crop (default value)
1: scale and display with a black background
fields.help_zh:
子画面输出时的显示模式。取值：
0：裁剪。（默认值）
1：缩放并显示黑底
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the background image. The maximum length is 2,048 characters
fields.help_zh: 背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The background image of the sub-picture. When a user turns off the camera, does not ingest a stream after joining the channel, or leaves the channel midway, the corresponding image is displayed in the layout position
fields.help_zh: 子画面背景图，当用户关闭摄像头、或入会后未推流、或入会后中途离会时，会在布局位置填充为对应的图片
fields.name: sub_background

fields.help_en:
The user ID corresponding to the window.
If UserId is not specified, the windows are filled in the order in which the subscribed users join the channel.
The combination of UserId and SourceType specified here must be included in SubscribeUserIdList.
Subscribed audio-only streams cannot be added to the layout
fields.help_zh:
该窗口对应的UserId。
不设置UserId时，会按照订阅的用户进入频道的顺序依次填入窗口。
这里设置的UserId与SourceType的组合必须包含在SubscribeUserIdList中。
订阅纯音频流是不能加入到布局中的
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The width of the pane, as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0,1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 窗格宽度，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The X coordinate, as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0,1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 坐标X，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The Y coordinate, as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0,1]. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 坐标Y，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The stacking order. 0 indicates the bottom layer, 1 indicates the layer above 0, and so on. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推。(默认为0)
fields.name: z_order

fields.help_en: The window layout information for subscribed users. Only user IDs with layout information configured are displayed in the video. This parameter is required in mixed-stream recording mode when the recording is not audio-only
fields.help_zh: 用于指定订阅的用户的窗口布局信息，只有设置了布局信息的UserId，才会被放到画面中。混流模式且录制非纯音频文件时必填
fields.name: user_panes

parameters.help_en: The updated layout parameters. This parameter is not required in single-stream recording mode. In mixed-stream recording mode, this parameter is required unless the transcoding is audio-only
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的布局相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下非纯音频转码时必填
parameters.name: mix_layout_params
